# Planning Overhead Insights — Charts Documentation

**Purpose:** Professional analysis of current benchmark data (planning overhead only)

## Chart 01: Planning LLM Calls Stability

![Planning LLM Calls Stability](01_planning_stability.png)

**Core Problem Statement**  
No visibility into how stable each model’s planning behavior is across runs.

**Core Claim**  
The 0.8B model shows high variance (up to 6 planning calls). Larger models remain stable at ~1 call.

**Description**  
Boxplot + strip plot showing distribution of LLM planning calls. Black dots = individual runs. Red μ = mean.

## Chart 02: Planning Efficiency (Tokens per LLM Planning Call)

![Planning Efficiency](02_planning_efficiency.png)

**Core Problem Statement**  
Cannot compare how many tokens each model spends per planning call.

**Core Claim**  
Larger models use more tokens per call but with tighter, more consistent distributions.

**Description**  
Boxplot of tokens consumed per individual LLM planning call. Lower = more efficient planning.

## Chart 03: Outlier Detection (Duration vs Total Tokens)

![Outlier Detection](03_outlier_detection.png)

**Core Problem Statement**

**Core Claim**

Scatter plot with point size by email limit. Red annotation highlights the major outlier.

## Chart 05: Planning LLM Calls Heatmap

**Core Problem Statement**

Professional diverging heatmap (Model × Email Limit). Blue = low planning overhead.
